name: ARIA dutasteride trials
question: Does dutasteride improve symptoms and reduce acute urinary retention and BPH surgery compared with placebo in men with symptomatic enlarged prostates?

design.blinding: double-blind after a single-blind placebo lead-in
design.population: Men with clinical BPH, AUA Symptom Index at least 12, Qmax at most 15 mL/s, prostate volume at least 30 cm3, and PSA 1.5–10 ng/mL.
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Methods; Debruyne 2004 PubMed abstract, Objectives

verdictNote: The abstract omits prespecified endpoints and arm-specific event rates.
takeaway: Across three randomized ARIA trials, dutasteride improved symptom score and peak flow and reduced acute urinary retention and BPH surgery compared with placebo over 24 months in men with symptomatic enlarged prostates.

reports.label: Pooled two-year report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation: September 2002; Crossref published-print: September 2002
reports.citation: Roehrborn CG, Boyle P, Nickel JC, et al. "Efficacy and safety of a dual inhibitor of 5-alpha-reductase types 1 and 2 (dutasteride) in men with benign prostatic hyperplasia." *Urology.* 2002;60(3):434-441. doi:10.1016/s0090-4295(02)01905-2

results.note: The abstract does not identify the prespecified primary endpoint or its threshold.

results.measure: Qmax change from baseline at 24 months
Relative risk reduction versus placebo over 24 months
Relative risk reduction versus placebo over 24 months
Mean change from baseline at 24 months

delivery.label: Treatment schedule
delivery.value: One-month single-blind placebo lead-in, then dutasteride 0.5 mg daily or placebo for 24 months.

reports.label: Four-year pooled extension
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation: October 2004; Crossref published-print: October 2004
reports.citation: Debruyne F, Barkin J, van Erps P, et al. "Efficacy and safety of long-term treatment with the dual 5 alpha-reductase inhibitor dutasteride in men with symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia." *Eur Urol.* 2004;46(4):488-495. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2004.05.008

values.ctl: placebo switched to dutasteride: further improvement

results.note: At month 48 the continued-dutasteride group had significantly greater symptom and flow improvement and volume reduction; all patients received dutasteride in the extension.

delivery.label: Open-label extension
delivery.value: Patients from all three pivotal trials were eligible; both original groups received dutasteride 0.5 mg daily during the 24-month extension.
